title: checkin_resource: lichen_checkin_resource_service() returns &s_service with no locking contract
description: Found in security review of untq fix. lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin_resource.c:64-67 returns the module-static service handle without s_lock and without a documented concurrency contract; the header says only '(read-only use recommended)'. Today the only callers are tests (lichen/tests/checkin_resource/src/main.c), but any future caller mutating s_service/s_checkins/s_rollcalls through it races the handlers' locked access incl. the lazy init check in service_tick_locked(). Fix: document a strict init-before-server-start / read-only contract in checkin_resource.h (and consider asserting the service is not yet serving), or route through a locked accessor.
